exposure: types of antibiotics (e.g., Metronidazole, ceftriaxone, meropenem, amoxicillin, vancomycin)
outcome: resistance distribution among WHO Access, Watch, and Reserve groups
prevalence of isolated bacteria (e.g., E. coli, Staphylococcus non-aureus spp., Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa)
cohort: The study included 6090 patients undergoing antimicrobial screening in public hospitals across Thi-Qar Governorate, with the majority (43.34%) aged 18-49 years.
finding: The study revealed prevalent empirical prescribing of broad-spectrum antibiotics, often without culture and sensitivity testing, and identified significant antimicrobial resistance among isolated bacteria with a notable difference in resistance distribution across WHO antibiotic groups.
